messages.subject: Postdoc job opportunity (a really good one)
parts:
Anyone who is really into the combination of ecology and statistics should apply to this postdoc (posting closes on 1 December).

I was a postdoc in David's lab and can say that it is a very good lab with a brilliant team. He has a big network of collaborators, as well. Finally, Sydney's eastern suburbs are incredibly beautiful, Australian postdocs are well-paid, and time on this job would count toward the five years needed for permanent residency.
-W
